description: You are the most important thing in your life , go where you grow 🍾 #growth #bigsisteradvice #fypシ #LifeByDesign
transcript: You have to be the most important thing in your life, and it is really that simple. The environments in which you exist and shape you, they shape your ideas, they shape your thoughts. It shapes the way that you communicate. You have to choose you first every single time, and if you don't like something, move. Move and shake and do it quickly. You are in such a prime season of life that you are experienced and you are ready to hit the go button. Don't let anyone tell you no. Don't let anyone stop you. You are the most important thing to you.
